:::{#exr-neg-agreement-harmonic}
#### Negative agreement from NPV and specificity

For an agreement table (@def-agreement-table) with $d > 0$,
write the [harmonic mean](#def-harmonic-mean)
of the estimated negative predictive value and specificity
(@def-agreement-test-measures)
in terms of the table's cells.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-neg-agreement-harmonic}

Because $d > 0$,
both $c + d$ and $b + d$ are positive,
so both estimates are defined and positive:

$$
\ba
H\paren{\Est{\text{NPV}}, \Est{\text{specificity}}}
&= \frac{2}{\frac{1}{\Est{\text{NPV}}} + \frac{1}{\Est{\text{specificity}}}}
&& \text{(definition of } H \text{)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{1}{d / (c + d)} + \frac{1}{\Est{\text{specificity}}}}
&& \text{(definition of } \Est{\text{NPV}} \text{)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{1}{d / (c + d)} + \frac{1}{d / (b + d)}}
&& \text{(definition of } \Est{\text{specificity}} \text{)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{c + d}{d} + \frac{1}{d / (b + d)}}
&& \text{(reciprocal of a fraction)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{c + d}{d} + \frac{b + d}{d}}
&& \text{(reciprocal of a fraction)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{(c + d) + (b + d)}{d}}
&& \text{(add fractions with a common denominator)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{c + d + b + d}{d}}
&& \text{(remove parentheses)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{d + d + b + c}{d}}
&& \text{(reorder terms)} \\
&= \frac{2}{\frac{2d + b + c}{d}}
&& \text{(} d + d = 2d \text{)} \\
&= 2 \cd \frac{d}{2d + b + c}
&& \text{(dividing by a fraction multiplies by its reciprocal)} \\
&= \frac{2d}{2d + b + c}
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exr-neg-agreement-harmonic}

:::
